title: 豎井沉井施工~Sinking-caisson shaft construction
focus: 沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮~Sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift
summary: 本課以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為主線，從下沉驅動與力系平衡與側摩阻與埋深累積建立系統邊界，再把井底滲流與有效應力、位移速率與突沉辨識連到永久抗浮與階段交接。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. It begins with Sinking drive and force equilibrium and Skin resistance and embedded depth, links Base seepage and effective stress and Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection, and ends with Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 下沉驅動與力系平衡~Sinking drive and force equilibrium
units.title: 下沉驅動與力系平衡~Sinking drive and force equilibrium
units.mechanism: 沉井自重與附加荷載提供下沉作用，浮力、側摩阻與刃腳反力則抵抗移動。各項會隨水位、接觸和土體擾動改變，靜態差值只表示假想瞬間的不平衡；突然卸阻時需要考慮動態和可控性，不能由力差直接決定施工動作。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按同一時刻比對重量、水位、位移及周邊接觸證據；若出現側摩阻突然降低使原本靜止井體突沉，平均平衡計算未捕捉動態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Caisson weight and surcharge drive sinking against buoyancy, skin friction and cutting-edge resistance. Water levels, contact and disturbed soil change these terms. A static difference describes a hypothetical instant, while sudden resistance loss involves dynamics and controllability; imbalance alone cannot prescribe field action. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare weight, water levels, movement and perimeter-contact evidence at a shared time. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sudden skin-resistance loss triggers rapid sinking that an average equilibrium calculation misses, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 側摩阻與埋深累積~Skin resistance and embedded depth
units.title: 側摩阻與埋深累積~Skin resistance and embedded depth
units.mechanism: 井壁與地層摩阻沿周邊和深度分布，不同土層、潤滑和接觸間隙使剪應力非均勻。平均值模型可顯示埋深敏感度，但上下段可能在不同時刻動員；停沉後黏著恢復也會改變再次移動所需力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將土層分段、井壁接觸與停沉前後荷重位移對照；若出現以淺層平均摩阻推估全深，漏掉高黏著層造成懸掛，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Wall friction distributes around the perimeter and depth, varying with layers, lubrication and gaps. A mean-stress model shows depth sensitivity, but upper and lower sections mobilize at different times. Adhesion recovered during a pause can further change the force needed to resume movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer intervals and wall contact with load-displacement before and after stoppages. If extrapolating shallow mean friction misses a high-adhesion layer that hangs up the caisson, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 刃腳環帶與局部支承~Cutting-edge annulus and local support
units.title: 刃腳環帶與局部支承~Cutting-edge annulus and local support
units.mechanism: 刃腳將井體荷載傳到下方土體，理想環帶面積不等於實際均勻接觸。地層軟硬差、刃角幾何和局部掏空會使壓力集中，還可能引起井壁彎曲；平均承壓只用於檢查量級，不能定義局部挖土範圍。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃腳高程、接觸分布與井壁環向應變；若出現局部硬層形成支點使井體傾斜，整圈平均承壓仍不異常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The cutting edge transfers load into underlying soil, but its geometric annulus is not necessarily uniformly engaged. Contrasting strata, edge geometry and local voids concentrate pressure and can bend the wall. Mean bearing checks scale only and cannot define a field excavation pattern. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutting-edge elevations, contact distribution and circumferential wall strain. If a local hard layer forms a pivot and tilts the caisson despite an unremarkable mean bearing stress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 井體傾斜與共同基準~Caisson tilt and shared survey datum
units.title: 井體傾斜與共同基準~Caisson tilt and shared survey datum
units.mechanism: 井體傾斜由對向高差與水平基線定義，單一側點下沉不能區分整體沉降與轉動。環向多點可檢查是否近似剛體，井壁彎曲或測點鬆動會破壞此假設；量測系統須與影響區外穩定基準連結。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以環向多點高程、井壁垂直度與外部基準閉合比對；若出現共同基準點沉陷讓井體傾斜被低估，修正判斷方向錯誤，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Tilt follows differential elevation over a horizontal baseline, while one sinking point cannot separate translation from rotation. Circumferential points test the rigid-body assumption, which wall bending or loose targets can invalidate. Tie measurements to stable reference points outside the influence zone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare perimeter elevations, wall verticality and external-datum closure. If settlement of a shared benchmark understates tilt and misdirects correction interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 井底滲流與有效應力~Base seepage and effective stress
units.title: 井底滲流與有效應力~Base seepage and effective stress
units.mechanism: 井內外水頭差沿井底滲流路徑產生梯度，向上滲流降低土體有效應力。平均路徑模型不能代表刃腳附近局部峰值，黏土不排水隆起也不是砂土臨界梯度問題；先辨識土類、方向和破壞機制再比較數值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照內外水頭、底部孔壓及出水含砂變化；若出現向上水力梯度集中於短路徑，出砂與土體鬆動逐步發展，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Head difference drives base seepage, and upward flow reduces effective stress. An average path misses local gradients near the cutting edge; undrained clay heave is distinct from granular critical-gradient behavior. Identify soil type, flow direction and mechanism before interpreting numerical comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare internal and external head, base pore pressure and sand content in seepage. If upward gradients concentrate along a short path and progressively mobilize sand and loosen soil, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 降水固結與鄰近沉陷~Dewatering consolidation and neighboring settlement

units.anchor: 位移速率與突沉辨識~Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection

A rate jump may reflect resistance collapse or sensor and clock error. Confirm it with synchronized independent data rather than inferring smooth motion from total progress over the reporting interval. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare high-frequency movement, clock synchronization and independent rim surveys. If a one-minute sinking event is diluted by a half-hour average and appears smooth in reports, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 封底自重與水壓作用~Base-plug weight and water-pressure action

units.mechanism: 封底承受向上水壓並把作用傳到井壁或其他核定抗浮系統，自重通常只是抵抗項之一。水下施工階段與排水後壓差不同，不能只確認混凝土厚度就判斷可轉換狀態；黏結、剪力傳遞與齡期強度另需驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭；若出現封底自重不足卻漏計或未證實壁面傳力，水壓使封底抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The base plug transfers uplift to the walls or another approved resisting system, with self-weight only one resistance component. Differential pressure changes between underwater and dewatered stages. Thickness alone cannot justify a stage change; bond, shear transfer and age-dependent strength need separate evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head. If insufficient plug weight combined with unverified wall transfer permits uplift displacement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 永久抗浮與階段交接~Permanent uplift resistance and stage handover

Temporary ballast is not automatically permanent resistance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將逐項確認永久重量、連接形成及設計水位版本列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現移除臨時壓重卻沿用舊抗浮計算，永久狀態抵抗不足，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Verify permanent weight, established connections and the design-water-level version item by item. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing temporary ballast while retaining the old uplift calculation overstates permanent resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查下沉驅動與力系平衡：netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN；再獨立檢查側摩阻與埋深累積：skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN。假設側摩阻由 3500 降至 2500 kN，其餘力不變，淨向下力由 500 增至 1500 kN；三倍差值不能推成三倍下沉速度。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 將對照封底厚度、齡期、井壁接觸及分階段水頭作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Sinking drive and force equilibrium: netDownward=8000 kN-3000 kN-3500 kN-1000 kN=500 kN. Independently check Skin resistance and embedded depth: skinResistance=tau*pi*D*depth=15 kPa*pi*10 m*20 m=9425 kN. If assumed skin resistance falls from 3500 to 2500 kN with other forces unchanged, net downward force rises from 500 to 1500 kN; tripling imbalance does not imply triple sinking speed. The two results are not a complete design because driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. Use compare plug thickness, age, wall contact and stage-specific head as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。Heathwall 2013 規劃提出沉井後轉托換，並非竣工證明；Cremorne 2020 紀錄採樁加噴凝土，特列為非沉井對照，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. The Heathwall 2013 proposal combines caisson sinking and underpinning and is not as-built evidence. The Cremorne 2020 account describes piles plus sprayed lining and is expressly a non-caisson comparison. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
